title: Paul's calling and separation for the gospel
english: "Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ, called to be an apostle, set apart for the gospel of God" (Romans 1:1). Called is not the same thing as chosen, for "many are called, but few are chosen" (Matthew 22:14). Set apart for the gospel: God sets apart the righteous from the womb. Paul was called not by chance but according to purpose.

title: The Son's twofold origin: from David's seed and predestined in power
english: What he had promised beforehand through his prophets in the holy Scriptures concerned his Son, who was made from the seed of David according to the flesh and was predestined as Son of God in power according to the Spirit of sanctification (Romans 1:2-4). He was made according to the flesh; according to the Spirit he is Son of God in power.

title: Faith announced, gospel not ashamed, righteousness from faith
english: Your faith is announced in the whole world (Romans 1:8). "I am not ashamed of the gospel: for it is the power of God for salvation to everyone who believes, to the Jew first and to the Greek" (Romans 1:16). God's righteousness is revealed from faith to faith; the righteous one lives from faith (Romans 1:17).

title: God's wrath revealed against unrighteousness
english: The wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all impiety and unrighteousness of people who hold the truth in unrighteousness (Romans 1:18). Therefore God handed them over to the desires of their heart, to passions of disgrace, to a reprobate mind (Romans 1:24, 26, 28). Glory to Christ. Amen.
